about_the_game:
Let yourself be carried away by the gentle melodies of Happy Pet, gathered in this music pack available in both standard and high quality. Whether you're creating, dreaming, working, or simply enjoying a peaceful moment, these tunes will accompany you with warmth and lightness.

Each note was lovingly composed to evoke a cozy world filled with joyful little creatures and soothing memories. It’s an invitation to slow down, to smile, to breathe.

By choosing this pack, you're not just getting a soundtrack, you're also offering direct support to an independent developer who pours heart and soul into every creation. Thank you for being part of this soft and colorful journey.
